predictions: Posting a 17-8 record last week didn't seem "too" bad, until I saw that it ties for my second worst week of the season so far. At the same time, it's pretty good news that I've been above 2/3 correct in all but one week. And of course, all but one incorrect pick were one dart from either tying or flipping the result. But that's how this goes… It all brings me to 124-50 (71.3% correct) for the season, which is about my norm so far. As is messing up a Trips Are For Kids pick… yep, 1-6 with them now.

Match of the week: (E Div.) Liquor Possee @ Runs with Corks. Oh, this was so close to being a matchup of 6-1 leaders here in E, but Dart Side escaped the Corkers in 1001 last week. So now this is just two of the top three, with each also facing a minor point deficit relative to E leader Dart Side. This looks like a repeat of the Corks' wk01 13-11 win.

Match #2: (F Div.) Shark Shooters @ Rippin Darts. Zero Dart took out everybody in F in the first half, while the next three teams all split within their group and now form a trio of 5-2 teams fighting to be the top chase team. In the last two weeks, both these teams have posted one huge win and took a Zero roasting. Rippin is the one who rebounds, 14-10.

Match #3: (G Div.) Dart Vader's @ Killer Dee's. Dee's big win back in wk04 is the reason these two sit only one match behind division-leading She Said. Vader's won their inaugural RDL match over Dee's back in week 1, but it feels like Dee's has slowly been ramping up over the last month. It will be close, but I think Dee's gets a little payback here, 13-11.

Match #4: (B Div.) Dart Attack @ Trips Are For Kids. I've picked the Kids to win twice. Both wrong. I've picked the Kids to lose five times. All wrong after week 1. They've lost to 2 of the bottom trio, and they've defeated 3 of the top non-Kids quartet. I'm not even going to act like I know what will happen, so my first inclination is just to pick the Kids so they have to lose to prove me wrong. If it was any opponent but Dart Attack, that's exactly how I would play this. But… Attack it is, 14-10.

Matches #5 & #6: (D Div.) Red-eye Rangers @ Ton 80 Proof; Village Idiots @ DD-214. Reload leads D at 5-1, and there are four teams sitting one or two matches behind them. Those four teams get together here in week 8, with the two 4-2s each facing one of the 3-3s. The weird part? The two 4-2s each lost to their respective 3-3 opponent seven weeks ago. As might be assumed from all that, these matchups are possibly the two most even pairings on this page. In the end, I'm taking both teams that lost last time around. Rangers and Idiots, 13-11 each.

Match #7: (A Div.) 2 Liver Die with LA @ Why So Serious? Don't look now... Serious has played their way into this being the pairing that might determine if any new A team will be climbing into the league's top four. Alas, Liver Die still holds their spot well. 15-9.

Matches #8 & #9: (B Div.) Put It on Matt's Tab @ Nine Lives; Inconsistently Consistent @ One Armed Bandits. Wow, only one match and 10 points separates the entirety of the bottom five in B. Two of those teams might well find themselves in C next season. Or is one of them about to start a run toward a top-two finish? Or both? Four of those bottom five tangle in matches here. I'll take Matt's Tab in 1001, while Consistent has a little more breathing room, 15-9.

Match #10: (C Div.) Rif Raf @ Off Constantly-Reboot. At first glance, this looks like a team 3 points out of first against a bottom-3 squad. And that's true. But that lower team just handed McGavin its first loss. Off Constantly better not sleep on this one… 13-11.
Match #11: (E Div.) Bangin The Wire @ Dart Side of the Moon. Dart Side escaped in 1001 last week, while Bangin only lost to the E leader by 2 after an 0-6 start. Game on, man. Still Dart Side, 14-10.
Match #12: (F Div.) The Dartifacts @ Coach's Last Dance. It has been a rough road for Coach, but even rougher for the Dartifacts. Is this the 'Facts last shot at hitting the win column? Coach, 15-9.
